questions.prompt:
Last term, a student team opened a repair corner in the library every Friday afternoon. Students could bring broken lamps and small electronic devices. The team charged nothing, but visitors were asked to watch the repair and learn one useful skill. Not every device could be repaired. Even so, the team recorded common problems and published a short guide. This term, two other departments plan to start similar activities.

Where did the team run the repair corner?
questions.explanation: 首句明确说明 opened a repair corner in the library；其余地点未出现。

questions.prompt:
Lena used to read messages whenever she studied. She often felt busy but remembered little. For one week, she put her phone in a bag and studied for twenty-five minutes at a time. After each session, she took a five-minute break. She did not study longer than before, yet she finished more tasks. Lena thinks the important change was fewer interruptions, not a longer working day.

What problem did Lena have before the experiment?
questions.explanation: 前两句描述频繁看消息且记住的内容很少，答案直接来自 remembered little。
